moments.selftext: Teenager flew from Sheffield to Essex via Germany because it was cheaper than taking the train. In 2016, 18-year-old Jordon Cox went viral after flying from Sheffield to Essex via Berlin, Germany, simply because it was cheaper than taking the train. A direct one-way rail ticket cost £47, while his combination of transit and Ryanair flights came to just £44.07. The roughly 1,000-mile detour took 13 hours but saved him nearly £3. It also gave him time to explore Berlin and grab a currywurst before continuing home.
